metadata.description: Kraft, a local orchestrator that takes your coding agent from spec to pull request, stopping only when a decision is yours; and Kraft Lite, its chains without the orchestrator.

plugins.name: kraft
plugins.description: Drive Kraft from an agent session: file work, read the board, act on gates, recover stopped work.

plugins.name: kraft-lite
